en: Black‑and‑white view of a cobblestoned city street intersection lined with multi‑story historic buildings. On the left, arched shopfronts with German‑language signage occupy the ground floor. On the right is an ornate corner building with a domed turret, bay windows, and decorative reliefs above the windows; shops are on the ground floor, including one with a curved sign above the entrance. People in early‑20th‑century clothing stroll or stand in the street; a few children and a cart are visible. The scene feels like a central street or square in a historic German town.
